panels.description: Keel public water point against patched mining infrastructure: rusted pump housings, narrow channels, stacked housing, dust, and three metered taps. A short non-recognizable queue waits with jugs. Alex approaches in his dark work clothes, rust-brown patched cargo trousers, scuffed boots, canvas tool bag, and oversized steel watch on his left wrist; one dim amber Bi11bot eye peers from the partly open bag. Put the display high and far right, separate from all balloon zones; leave upper-left and lower-right clear for lettering.
Alex’s scarred hand grips the patched pump housing as it shudders. Empty jugs blur behind him. Leave upper-left clear for one balloon.

Alex kneels at the open pump with tools arranged on concrete. Bi11bot’s articulated finger widens the bag zipper and his amber eye blinks. Leave upper-left clear for Bi11bot’s small whispered balloon and lower-right beside Alex for his quiet reply.

Alex looks toward the queue; a child’s empty jug rests beneath the dead tap. His oversized steel watch slips down his left wrist. Keep the display distant and unobstructed; reserve upper-left for Alex and upper-right for the queue worker.
